issue.title: Allow to switch to single decoding mode

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
In our *Decoder implementation we always try to decode as many messages as possible. This is the best performance wise but is sometimes problematic. Especially when you are about to do a protocol upgrade and so will replace the decoder.

To fix this we should provide a way to switch to only decode one message per inboundBuffferUpdated(..) call. This will also fix #864.
